matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN augments the Faster R-CNN detector with an additional, parallel head that outputs a per-instance binary segmentation mask for each proposal.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN extends Faster R-CNN by adding a branch for predicting an object mask in parallel with the existing branch for bounding box recognition.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: ROIAlign replaces ROIPool by removing harsh feature quantization, which substantially improves mask localization accuracy.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The proposed RoIAlign layer improves mask accuracy by relative 10% to 50%, showing bigger gains under stricter localization metrics.
